name: Chang Hsü
bio: Chang Hsü lived in the early 8th century AD.
The poems here are Witter Bynner’s versions, from the texts of Kiang Kang-hu, in The Jade Mountain (1929).

poems.title: Peach-Blossom River
poems.author: Chang Hsü
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
A bridge flies away through a wild mist,
Yet here are the rocks and the fisherman’s boat.
Oh, if only this river of floating peach-petals
Might lead me at last to the mythical cave!
